title: "Themes"

vinOS ships **10 themes** — six dark, four light — each anchored to a
real Unsplash photograph and one of the community's proven color
palettes (tokyonight, gruvbox, nord, catppuccin-latte, everforest).
Every theme overrides the accent color with the family-signature
vinOS teal `#4EC1B8`, so you always know you're on vinOS regardless
of the mood.

- **[Switching themes](/docs/themes/switching-themes/)** — one command,
  one keybinding, everything reloads.
- **[The vinOS 10](/docs/themes/the-vinos-10/)** — the catalog with
  photographer credits and palette rationale.
- **[Building your own](/docs/themes/building-your-own/)** — add a
  wallpaper, add a palette row, regenerate.
